errors.text_span: bleibt dann bis 2020 relativ stabil bei etwa 3,0 %
errors.evidence: The blue line representing 'städtische Räume' is not stable between 2018 and 2020. It rises from approx. 3.3% in 2018 to 3.4% in 2019, and then drops to approx. 2.9% in 2020. Describing this movement as 'relatively stable at about 3.0%' is an over-generalization.
The description of the black line does not mention the error bars that are clearly visible on its data points.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis 2017 relativ stabil bei etwa 0,5 %
errors.evidence: The black line, representing the difference, shows a clear increasing trend from approx. 0.5% in 2013 to approx. 0.8% in 2016 before it drops in 2017. It is not 'relatively stable at about 0.5%' during this period.

errors.text_span: fällt leicht auf etwa 0,3 % im Jahr 2017
errors.evidence: The value of the black line in 2017 is approximately 0.4%, not 0.3%.
The value of the black line in 2019 is approximately 1.0%, not 0.9%.

The black line does not remain at about 0.7% from 2019 to 2022. It peaks at ~1.0% in 2019 and 2020, then decreases to ~0.9% in 2021 and ~0.8% in 2022. The description misrepresents both the trend (it's decreasing, not stable) and the values.
